p: The High Street is the beating heart of Dumfries, and the old Midsteeple, the town's 18th-century former town house, stands on it, so you'll have no trouble getting your bearings. The River Nith runs just to the west, with the old Devorgilla Bridge and a pleasant riverside walk.

Dumfries is Robert Burns' town. He spent his last years here, and you can visit Burns House, where he died, and his mausoleum in St Michael's kirkyard, both a short walk from the centre. Across the river, the Robert Burns Centre tells the story of the poet and the town.
If you're popping into Norona, remember it's adults only, and ID helps if you look under 25.
